recommendation.diagnosis: The candidate is structurally valid, matches the medium difficulty target, and has high novelty. suggested_edits.description: Separate the enemy from the gap near column 9 by moving the enemy at least 2-3 columns away from the gap, or relocating the gap so it does not coincide with the enemy.
suggested_edits.reason: This will reduce the frustration caused by the layered hazard, aligning the segment with the intent for a less frustrating, medium-difficulty experience.
